items.headline: Claude Code's Desktop App Can Now Pick Up Where It Left Off Automatically
items.summary: Anthropic added a simple "auto-continue" checkbox to the Claude Code desktop app. Turn it on before you hit your usage limit, and once your limit window resets, Claude Code automatically picks the task back up instead of sitting idle until you manually restart it.
items.why_it_matters: If you ever let Claude Code run a long editing, scripting, or automation job and step away, this means you don't have to be at your keyboard the second your limit resets just to keep it moving.

opportunity.action_note: Open Claude Code desktop settings and turn on the "Auto-continue when limits reset" checkbox if you ever run long unattended tasks.

items.headline: Claude Code Update Lets Your AI Sessions Message Each Other, Plus a Dozen Security Fixes
items.summary: Anthropic shipped a big Claude Code update on August 14 that lets you type @ to tag another running Claude Code session by name and send it a message directly, turns on "sub-agent forking" by default so helper agents share memory instead of starting from scratch, and closes 12 security gaps around permissions and sandboxing.
items.why_it_matters: If you use Claude Code for editing scripts, managing projects, or automating parts of your workflow, this makes it noticeably better at handling bigger, multi-step jobs without losing context or slipping outside the boundaries you set.

items.headline: Anthropic Signs $9 Billion, 20-Year Power Deal With Former Bitcoin Miner Riot Platforms
items.summary: Anthropic locked in a $9.1 billion computing deal with Riot Platforms, a company that used to focus purely on bitcoin mining, to get dedicated power and data center space in Texas for running Claude. The contract runs through 2048 and could grow to roughly $16 billion with renewal options.
items.why_it_matters: This is another sign Anthropic is betting heavily on Claude's long-term growth and locking in the electricity and computing power to back it up, useful context if you're deciding how much of your workflow to build around Claude.

items.headline: Microsoft Is Shutting Off Free Deep Research and Three Other Copilot Features on August 18
items.summary: As part of merging its two Copilot apps into one, Microsoft confirmed that free-tier Deep Research, Group Chats, Copilot Labs, and the animated Mico character all disappear from Copilot on August 18. The stronger replacement for Deep Research, called Researcher, will cost $19.99 a month.
items.why_it_matters: If you or your team use Microsoft Copilot's free research tools for content research or business planning, save anything you rely on before August 18 and budget for the new $19.99/month tier if you want to keep that level of research power.

opportunity.action_note: If you use Copilot's free Deep Research, Group Chats, or Labs features, save what you need before August 18 since they're being retired that day.

items.headline: ChatGPT Can Now Pull Files Straight From Your Google Drive
items.summary: OpenAI added Google Drive support to ChatGPT's Library, so paid users can browse their Drive folders, mention a Doc, Sheet, or Slide right in a chat with @, and work with it side by side without re-uploading the file every time.
items.why_it_matters: If you keep your scripts, show notes, or client documents in Google Drive, this saves you the annoying step of downloading and re-uploading files just to get ChatGPT's help with them.

items.headline: Google's Gemini Can Now Turn a Spreadsheet Into an Interactive Mini-App
items.summary: Google started rolling out "Sheets canvas" on August 14, a Gemini-powered feature that lets you type a plain-English request, like "build a visual client tracker," and turns a Google Sheet into a custom interactive layout, no formulas or coding required. Changes sync back to the original spreadsheet automatically.
items.why_it_matters: If you track clients, bookings, or inventory in Google Sheets, this could save you from paying for a separate app just to make that spreadsheet easier for you or your team to actually use day to day.

opportunity.angle: I turned my client tracker spreadsheet into a mini-app with Gemini's new Sheets canvas, here's how it went

items.headline: OBSBOT's August Update Adds Gesture Controls to Its AI Avatar Camera Feature
items.summary: OBSBOT's August firmware and software update lets you trigger its AI Avatar mode with hand gestures on the Tiny 3 and Tiny 3 Lite webcams, adds a new "Dynamic Camera View" in the OBSBOT Center app, and improves performance in Lite Mode.
items.why_it_matters: If you stream or record with an OBSBOT camera, this free update is worth installing, it makes switching into an AI avatar or adjusting your camera framing mid-stream faster without digging through menus.

opportunity.action_note: If you use an OBSBOT Tiny 3 or Tiny 3 Lite camera, update its firmware and the OBSBOT Center software this week to get the new gesture and camera view controls.

items.headline: CapCut's Desktop App Adds a Much More Controllable AI Video Generator
items.summary: CapCut rolled out Seedance 2.5, ByteDance's newest AI video model, directly into its desktop app. It can generate 4K video up to 30 seconds long (180 seconds in a beta "Long Video Mode") from text or images, with more control over camera movement and keeping a character consistent across multiple clips.
items.why_it_matters: If you make YouTube intros, ads, or short-form clips, this gives you a genuinely more controllable AI video generator built into a free editing app you may already use, instead of needing to pay for a separate tool.

opportunity.angle: I tried CapCut's new AI video generator for a YouTube intro, here's what it can actually do

items.headline: X Is Retiring Its Creator Payout Program on September 7, Replacing It With Stricter Rules
items.summary: X stopped accepting new signups for its Creator Revenue Sharing program on August 7 and will fully retire it on September 7, replacing it with a new "Original Content Rewards" program. The new program cuts off payouts for engagement-bait posts (like "reply and I'll follow you back") and for reposted or lightly-edited content.
items.why_it_matters: If you or anyone in the community earns money from posts on X, check which program you're enrolled in now, since the payout rules are changing and content that used to earn will stop qualifying after September 7.

opportunity.action_note: If you earn X Creator Revenue Sharing payouts, review the new Original Content Rewards rules before September 7 so your posts keep qualifying.
